page_title: MEX 0-0 POL | Mexico v Poland 22/11/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.

90+7' Uriel Antuna (Mexico) superbly controls a difficult pass on the edge of the box and effortlessly let's fly with a magnificent low strike towards the middle of the goal, which the keeper somehow pushes away.

90+6' What an opportunity! Grzegorz Krychowiak (Poland) picked the ball up and fired a projectile of a shot from long range which threatened the goalkeeper. The shot went painfully close to the left post!

90+5' Hirving Lozano (Mexico) is all over the pitch today. He is full of energy and asking for the ball, while his ability to control the game and to be on the ball is simply fantastic. Every manager wants to have a playmaker like him.
90+5' Jakub Kaminski (Poland) receives a diagonal pass, bursts into the box and shoots towards the middle of the goal. Guillermo Ochoa is well positioned, though, and it's a comfortable save.
90+2' Edson Alvarez (Mexico) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
90+1' Luis Chavez (Mexico) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
90+1' Uriel Antuna (Mexico) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Mexico have been awarded a corner kick.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
89' Hirving Lozano (Mexico) bursts past a couple of players and shoots from the edge of the box, but his shot is blocked.
88' Matty Cash (Poland) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
87' Czeslaw Michniewicz has decided to make a change. Arkadiusz Milik (Poland) replaces Piotr Zielinski.
86' Hirving Lozano (Mexico) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders.
85' A pass from Uriel Antuna (Mexico) is intercepted by Wojciech Szczesny and the move breaks down.
84' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alexis Vega leaves the pitch and Uriel Antuna (Mexico) comes on.
84' Luis Chavez (Mexico) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
83' Jesus Gallardo (Mexico) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Mexico win a corner.
82' Grzegorz Krychowiak (Poland) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
82' Piotr Zielinski (Poland) will take the corner.
82' Matty Cash (Poland) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The ball is out of play. Poland win a corner kick.

80' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Alexis Vega (Mexico) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Poland will have a goal kick.
79' Raul Jimenez (Mexico) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play. Mexico will take a throw-in.
79' The attendance for today's match is 39369.
76' Jesus Gallardo (Mexico) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
76' Przemyslaw Frankowski (Poland) has tested the patience of referee Chris Beath and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
75' Bartosz Bereszynski (Poland) commits a foul during an attacking move.
74' The corner is swung in but Poland can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
74' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Przemyslaw Frankowski (Poland). Good work from Poland as they win a corner.

73' Jakub Kiwior (Poland) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and goes well wide of the left post.
71' Here comes a substitution. Przemyslaw Frankowski (Poland) is brought on as a substitute for Sebastian Szymanski.
71' Gerardo Martino decides to make a substitution. Henry Martin will be replaced by Raul Jimenez (Mexico).
71' Substitution. Hector Herrera walks off the pitch and Carlos Rodriguez (Mexico) comes on as a substitute.
70' Carlos Rodriguez (Mexico) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! A free kick has been awarded to Poland.

69' Hector Moreno (Mexico) reacts well and displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick. He jumps high and produces a header which goes well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Poland will have a goal kick.
68' Chris Beath couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Matty Cash (Poland) and blew his whistle. Mexico are awarded a free kick.
67' Alexis Vega (Mexico) latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box, but miskicks his shot and the ball goes high over the bar. Poor effort!
66' Jesus Gallardo (Mexico) passes the ball onto Henry Martin, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
64' What a save from Wojciech Szczesny! Henry Martin (Mexico) jumps high to meet a cross and glances a promising header from close range, but the goalkeeper pulls off a brilliant stop to keep it out.
63' Sebastian Szymanski (Poland) jumps into a tackle and Chris Beath signals a foul.
60' Alexis Vega (Mexico) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
59' Hirving Lozano (Mexico) goes on a mazy run and ends with a shot from the edge of the box, but a defender makes a decent block.
58' Sebastian Szymanski (Poland) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
58' Robert Lewandowski (Poland) doesn't take advantage of the chance to score from the penalty spot. He shoots to the bottom right corner, but Guillermo Ochoa leaps out to thwart his effort.
57' Robert Lewandowski (Poland) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
56' Hector Moreno (Mexico) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
56' The Poland players are happy as the referee awards a PENALTY after the VAR review!
55' There's a break in play and referee Chris Beath must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Poland using VAR. This could be interesting!
55' Jakub Kiwior (Poland) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Chris Beath blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick to Mexico.
54' PENALTY APPEAL after Robert Lewandowski (Poland) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
52' The goalkeeper denies the long-range shot from Hirving Lozano (Mexico). It wasn't such a big threat for him.
52' Luis Chavez (Mexico) whips in a cross from the corner, but Wojciech Szczesny is well positioned and punches the ball away.

51' Hirving Lozano (Mexico) attempts to find Jorge Sanchez with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention. Mexico will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
49' Piotr Zielinski (Poland) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play.
49' Cesar Montes (Mexico) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Poland have been awarded a free kick.
48' Cesar Montes (Mexico) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Chris Beath blows his whistle for an infringement.
48' Mexico seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
46' Czeslaw Michniewicz makes a half-time substitution. Krystian Bielik (Poland) comes on in place of Nicola Zalewski.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Chris Beath blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' A cross from Hirving Lozano (Mexico) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Alexis Vega (Mexico) swings in a cross from the corner, but Wojciech Szczesny reads it well and gathers the ball.

45' Jorge Sanchez (Mexico) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and fires a nice strike from a promising distance towards the roof of the net. Wojciech Szczesny has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save. The ball is out of play and Mexico manage to earn a corner.
43' An attempted cross from Jorge Sanchez (Mexico) is cleared.
42' Sebastian Szymanski (Poland) tries to find Jakub Kaminski, but he puts too much power on the pass.
40' Luis Chavez (Mexico) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

39' Hirving Lozano (Mexico) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort. Mexico force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
38' Grzegorz Krychowiak (Poland) commits a foul and Chris Beath immediately signals a free kick.
37' The total number of attempts is 3:1.
37' Jesus Gallardo (Mexico) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Wojciech Szczesny, who smothers the ball.
35' Cesar Montes (Mexico) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates. The ball goes out of play and Poland will have a goal kick.
33' Henry Martin (Mexico) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Wojciech Szczesny intercepts the ball.
31' The ball is cleared after Matty Cash (Poland) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
30' Nicola Zalewski (Poland) whips the ball in from the long-range free kick, but the first man gets it clear.
29' What was Jorge Sanchez (Mexico) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
28' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Jesus Gallardo (Mexico) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just wide of the left post.
28' Luis Chavez (Mexico) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Jesus Gallardo, but Wojciech Szczesny displays great awareness to stop him.
26' What a chance that is! Hector Herrera swings the ball into the box, and Alexis Vega (Mexico) gets in front of his man and powers his header just wide of the right post.
26' Grzegorz Krychowiak (Poland) attempts to release Robert Lewandowski with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players.
24' Edson Alvarez (Mexico) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Poland will have a goal kick.
23' Henry Martin (Mexico) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Chris Beath no option but to blow his whistle.
19' Hirving Lozano (Mexico) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
19' 61:39 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
18' Jorge Sanchez (Mexico) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
17' Chris Beath blows the whistle, Matty Cash (Poland) is penalised for a foul.
16' Jorge Sanchez (Mexico) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
14' Kamil Glik (Poland) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
13' Hector Moreno (Mexico) misses a promising opportunity! He rises for a cross and unleashes a poor header from near the penalty spot. The ball floats high over the crossbar!
12' Mexico quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
12' Jesus Gallardo (Mexico) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Mexico get a corner.
11' Jakub Kaminski (Poland) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mexico.
8' The corner kick from Piotr Zielinski (Poland) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
8' Piotr Zielinski (Poland) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
8' Robert Lewandowski (Poland) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked. The ball goes out of play and Poland have been awarded a corner kick.
7' Piotr Zielinski (Poland) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
6' Robert Lewandowski (Poland) sprays a pass out to Jakub Kaminski, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
5' Hirving Lozano (Mexico) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Alexis Vega, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
4' Edson Alvarez (Mexico) attempts to create a scoring opportunity with a wonderful long ball, but his pass is blocked.
2' A clumsy foul by Piotr Zielinski (Poland) and Chris Beath blows his whistle.
1' Jakub Kaminski (Poland) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Mexico will take the kick-off.
Chris Beath is the one to supervise the game today.
